sources.entry: Kaneo - Project management platform focused on simplicity and efficiency. (Demo, Source Code) MIT K8S/Docker

summary.one_liner: Kaneo is an open-source project management platform focused on simplicity, offered as a Kaneo Cloud service or self-hosted installation.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Kaneo as project management software with Board, List, Calendar, and Gantt views, plus a backlog, filters, and search. Tasks can carry descriptions, attachments, subtasks, dependencies, labels, comments, and time tracking. Teams get shared workspaces, invitations, custom roles, live updates, and public project views. Workflows can be shaped with custom columns and fields, and rules that move tasks when repository activity changes. Notifications go out in-app, by email, ntfy, Gotify, and personal webhooks. Integrations listed include GitHub and Gitea, chat integrations, project webhooks, a REST API, a command-line client, and MCP for AI assistants.
use_cases: Track software development tasks on a Kanban board or Gantt chart
Manage team projects with shared workspaces and custom roles
Link tasks to GitHub or Gitea repository activity
Self-host a project management tool for a team
Share public project views with outside stakeholders
Get task notifications via email, ntfy, or Gotify
how_to_run: Self-hosted: follow the installation guide linked in the README
Cloud: sign up for Kaneo Cloud
notable: Repository-driven automation rules that move tasks when GitHub or Gitea activity changes
Multiple views: Board, List, Calendar, Gantt, and backlog
MCP support for AI assistants and a command-line client
Public project views and custom roles for teams
Notifications via ntfy, Gotify, email, and personal webhooks
caveats: Self-hosting requires following the separate installation guide; the README gives no setup commands
A Cloud-hosted option is offered alongside self-hosting; its pricing is not stated in the README
